claims.text: The driver's own trace shows he held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 420 seconds, which is longer than the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the driver's side and the dwell requirement does not defeat the fee.

The rider's own device track places the rider within 20.9 m of the pickup pin for the whole window, well inside the 100 m rider presence radius for a STANDARD zone, so the rider was at the pickup point and the driver's no-show claim is not explained by rider absence.

The rider sent two locating messages during the waiting window - 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you' at 10:06:47 and 'hello? are you here' at 10:08:47 - and the driver never replied in the chat log and placed no in-app voice call before cancelling at 10:13:19, so POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are satisfied and the rider is exonerated.

The rider's messages went unread - both carry read_at null - and the driver's silence across the 6 minute 32 second interval from the first message to cancellation is a driver-side coordination failure, not a rider no-show.

The driver's arrival marker was pressed at 10:06:17 and the free waiting period of 180 seconds started at 10:06:19, but the driver cancelled at 10:13:19 - 420 seconds later - so the cancellation was not premature and POL-NS-06 does not apply on the driver's side.

No traffic advisory covers Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru in this window - the advisory artifact is MISSING with weight 0.0 - so POL-NS-06 limb (i) cannot be run and the driver cannot rely on a kerb restriction or enforcement operation to accumulate dwell across separate intervals.

The fare breakdown shows the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 was charged and remains CHARGED with no refund issued, so the rider is currently carrying the disputed charge and a ruling in the rider's favour would return it.

The rider has no no-show disputes in the trailing 30 days and no disputes with this driver in the trailing 90 days, so there is no pattern of rider abuse that would support the driver's no-show claim.

The driver has one no-show termination in the trailing 30 days against 134 completed trips, a rate of 0.0075, which is below the 0.08 anti-farming threshold, so the driver's compensation is not withheld on that ground - but the rider's own evidence still defeats the fee.
The rider's track shows a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph across 67 fixes, confirming the rider was stationary at the pickup point throughout the waiting window rather than elsewhere.

claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous qualifying run of 420 seconds, from 10:06:17 to 10:13:17, with 44 qualifying fixes — comfortably past the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). POL-NS-01 limb (c) is therefore satisfied on the driver's own evidence.

The trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 10:06:17 and a wait_timer_started event at 10:06:19, and the GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 10:06:17 — the same second. POL-NS-01 limb (a) holds, and limb (b) holds because the driver was inside the geofence at or before that event.

The trip terminated at 10:13:19 by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three reason codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and it falls well after the 180 second dwell elapsed at 10:09:17. No boarding event is recorded. Limb (d) holds.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: the driver's trace shows a distinct speed of 0.0 kph at the arrival moment and the qualifying run begins at the arrival timestamp, so the marker was not tapped from a moving vehicle or from more than 300 m away. The waiting clock therefore runs from the arrival event as recorded, and the corrected dwell is the same 420 seconds.

The rider's own track corroborates that the rider was present and stationary: 67 rider fixes, all at 0.0 kph, with a mean distance of 17.66 m and a maximum of 20.89 m — inside the 100 m STANDARD rider presence radius. This is not a case of a rider who was never at the pickup; the rider was there and the driver was there, and the pickup still failed.

The rider's two messages (10:06:47 and 10:08:47) went unanswered, but POL-NS-04 limb (b) is not the only route to a refund and the driver's conduct here is not the deciding fact: the driver held position in the geofence for the full waiting period and terminated on a recognised no-show code. The rider's silence in the chat is not a ground to refund a fee the driver earned by waiting.

The fare_breakdown reconciles: the cancellation_fee line is 4.50, which equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (4.50) and the fee_schedule.defaults figure, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect and the charge is the correct net amount.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, which is below the 4-or-more limb, and 1/134 = 0.0075, which is below the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs are required, so compensation is payable rather than withheld.

The driver is therefore owed compensation at 80 percent of the 4.50 cancellation fee in force, which is 3.60 SGD, per POL-NS-07 and the driver_compensation_rate constant. The fee itself stands and the rider's claim is not supported.

No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee: the driver's stationary fixes are inside the 50 m arrival radius, not in the 50–400 m wrong-entrance band of POL-NS-03, and the dwell is not short of the minimum under POL-NS-06. The POL-NS-06(i) accumulation limb is unavailable because EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING — no advisory covers this pickup — and I do not assert it; the single 420 second run needs no accumulation.

The rider's profile does not support escalation on abuse grounds: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, below the 3-or-more trigger of POL-NS-09(d), and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so the 2-or-more same-pair trigger of POL-NS-09(c) does not fire.

I concede the rider's point that the driver never replied to either message and placed no in-app call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty and the chat shows no driver message. That is a real coordination failure on the driver's side and it is why the rider's frustration is understandable, but it does not defeat the fee: POL-NS-04 requires the rider's presence limb (c) AND the unanswered-message limbs (a) and (b) together, and even where they hold the clause refunds the fee; here the driver's full 420 second in-geofence wait is independently established, and the fee is what the waiting period was paid for.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and the driver receives no compensation.

What the record shows. The driver accepted at 10:00:32, tapped 'I'm Here' at 10:06:17, the free-wait timer started at 10:06:19 and he cancelled at 10:13:19 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW (EV-TRIP-02715). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02715) shows one continuous in-geofence run of 420 seconds, from 10:06:17 to 10:13:17, on 44 qualifying fixes, so the driver did hold position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for longer than the 180 second free waiting period in force. The driver's points are correct as far as they go: POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) are each made out, the arrival marker was not false under POL-NS-05 (speed at the marker 0.0 kph, inside the radius), and the ledger reconciles — the 4.50 charged equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect.

Why the fee is refunded anyway. POL-NS-01 says the fee stands only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 does displace it. All three of its limbs hold. (a) The chat log (EV-CHAT-02715) shows the rider sent 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you' at 10:06:47 and 'hello? are you here' at 10:08:47, both inside the waiting window and both locating/coordinating messages. (b) The driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of either message, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty (EV-TRIP-02715) — he made no in-app call at any point before cancelling; the driver's own advocate concedes this. (c) The rider's device track in EV-GPS-02715 places the rider a mean 17.66 m and at most 20.89 m from the pin across 67 qualifying fixes, all at 0.0 kph, well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider presence radius. On those facts POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider and refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation.

Claims answered. The driver's claims that the 420 second dwell satisfies POL-NS-01 and that the 4.50 charge is properly made are accepted as findings but outweighed by POL-NS-04. The driver's claim to SGD 3.60 compensation (80 percent of 4.50 under POL-NS-07) is rejected: POL-NS-04 provides the refund with no driver compensation payable, so POL-NS-07 is not reached. The claim that the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1 against 134 completed trips, rate 0.0075) is accepted but moot. The rider's claims are accepted: there is no POL-NS-06 shortfall (420 s against a 180 s minimum), no false arrival marker under POL-NS-05, and the fare line shows 4.50 charged with no refund issued.

Discarded claims and their effect. Two claims were discarded before the ruling for citing the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02715-01 (weight 0.0) without naming its issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT. They change nothing here: the driver's dwell is a single continuous 420 second run, so the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation limb they invoked is not needed, and the missing advisory carries no deciding fact.

Escalation and referrals. No escalation applies: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, no admissible artifact contradicts another on arrival, dwell or rider presence, and the deciding facts (the chat log, the trip record's call list and the rider track) all rest on artifacts at full weight 1.0, so the confidence stands at 0.90 against a cap of 1.0 and above the 0.70 floor. No clause produces a referral: the arrival marker was genuine, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire. The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is at or below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so this refund executes on issue. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.50 no-show fee is refunded in full to the rider.

What the record shows. DRV-09715 tapped 'I'm Here' at 10:06:17 (EV-TRIP-02715) and the free waiting period of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180) began at 10:06:19. His own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02715) places him stationary inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius continuously from 10:06:17 to 10:13:17 — a 420 second qualifying run over 44 fixes — and he cancelled at 10:13:19 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The driver's claims that POL-NS-01 limbs (a), (b), (c) and (d) are all met are accepted, and so is his POL-NS-05 claim that the arrival marker was not false (0.0 kph at the marker, inside the radius, so no recomputation is needed). The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02715) also reconciles: the 4.50 cancellation-fee line equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd (4.50) and the fee_schedule.defaults figure, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

Why the rider still wins. POL-NS-04 gives the rider a separate, complete answer, and it applies on these facts. (a) The chat log (EV-CHAT-02715) shows the rider sent two locating messages inside the waiting window: 'im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you' at 10:06:47 and 'hello? are you here' at 10:08:47. (b) The driver posted no reply anywhere in the chat and left trip_record.in_app_calls empty, so no reply came within 120 seconds of either message and no in-app call was made before he terminated — the driver's own advocate concedes this. (c) The rider's track (EV-GPS-02715) places the rider's device 13.9 m to 20.9 m from the pin across 67 stationary fixes, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius for all qualifying fixes. On POL-NS-04 the rider is exonerated and 'the cancellation fee is refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable'. The rider's claims to that effect are accepted; the driver's contrary claim that his full wait outweighs it is rejected, because POL-NS-07 pays compensation only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied 'and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it', and POL-NS-04 is one of those clauses. The anti-farming test on EV-DPROF-02715 (1 no-show termination in 30 days; 1/134 = 0.0075) does not trip, but clearing that test only removes a bar to compensation — it does not create the entitlement once POL-NS-04 applies, so the driver's 3.60 SGD claim is rejected.

Amounts and thresholds. EV-FARE-02715 shows the cancellation fee of 4.50 charged with refund_issued_sgd 0.00; the sum returned to the rider is SGD 4.50. No driver compensation is paid. POL-NS-06 does not apply because the 420 second dwell exceeds the 180 second minimum by 240 seconds, and the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation limb is unavailable anyway (EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING); the single continuous run needs no accumulation, so the absent advisory decides nothing. The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00.

No escalation. No POL-NS-08(a)-(d) impairment exists: the trace has 100% coverage with no gap over 120 seconds and both tracks present, the chat log holds the two messages its numbering implies, and the fee line reconciles. POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not met (0 and 0 same-counterparty disputes; rider no-show disputes 0; driver no-show terminations 1). Every artifact carrying a deciding fact — EV-CHAT-02715, EV-TRIP-02715 and EV-GPS-02715 — has weight_multiplier 1.0, so nothing is discounted and confidence stands above the 0.70 floor.

Audit note: two claims were discarded before the debate, both for citing the MISSING advisory (EV-ADVIS-02715-01, weight 0.0) without naming its issue code as POL-GEN-02(1) requires. Neither was needed to decide this case.

WHY — POL-NS-04. This clause exonerates a rider who is at the pickup, tries to coordinate in the chat, and gets no answer from the driver, and it refunds the fee in full with no compensation to the driver. All three limbs hold on this record. ruling.explanation:
To the driver: your waiting is fully confirmed by the record, but the platform's own rule for an unanswered rider message decides this case, and it does not turn on your wait. To the rider: the SGD 4.50 no-show fee on trip TRP-02715 is refunded in full and no payment goes to the driver.

The driver's side first. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02715) carries a driver 'arrived' event at 10:06:17 and a termination at 10:13:19 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, with no boarding event. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02715) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup geofence at 10:06:17 and holds him there for a continuous 420 seconds to 10:13:17, on 44 qualifying fixes — longer than the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) are therefore all made out on the driver's own evidence, and the arrival marker was not false: the driver was stationary at 0.0 kph at the arrival moment and the qualifying run begins at the arrival timestamp, so POL-NS-05 does not engage. Your counterparty statement ('I waited the full time') is consistent with the trace and I have taken it as such. Standing alone, the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee in the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02715) would stand and POL-NS-07 would fix your payout at 80 percent, SGD 3.60.

That is not the end of it, and it is why the driver's claims that the fee stands and that SGD 3.60 is payable are rejected. POL-NS-04 is one of the clauses from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 that displaces POL-NS-01, and all three of its limbs hold on the record. (a) The rider sent two messages inside the waiting window, at 10:06:47 ('im at the pickup, which car are you? i cant see you') and 10:08:47 ('hello? are you here'), each of which is locating or coordinating. (b) The driver never replied in the chat log within 120 seconds of either message and placed no in-app voice call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. (c) The rider's own device track places the rider within 20.89 m of the pin at their furthest, across 67 qualifying fixes at 0.0 kph, well inside the 100 m presence radius for a STANDARD zone. Where all three hold, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider and refunds the cancellation fee in full, with no driver compensation payable: a rider who is at the pin and trying to coordinate, and is met with silence, has done what the platform asks, and the failed pickup becomes a driver-side coordination failure. The concession in the driver's own case that no reply was sent and no call placed is accepted, and it is decisive against the fee rather than neutral. The rider's presence track also disposes of any suggestion that the rider was elsewhere.

Nothing is down-weighted, and I have checked POL-NS-08 expressly. There is no clock skew (the 'arrived' event at 10:06:17 matches a GPS fix); no trace defect (maximum gap 0 s across 84 fixes, rider track present); no chat defect (the two messages reconcile with trip_record.chat_message_count and the msg_id sequence is intact); and no fare defect (the cancellation-fee line of 4.50 equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd = 4.50). EV-ADVIS-02715-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, but it carries no deciding fact here — the single unbroken 420 second in-geofence run needs no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) — so it neither caps confidence nor displaces anything. The claims resting on it were discarded on the referee's disclosure check and are not relied on by either side's surviving case.

No escalation trigger fires. Confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; neither profile shows the same-pair or abuse counters that POL-NS-09(c) and (d) read (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0, driver no_show_terminations_30d is 1 of 134 completed trips, below both anti-farming limbs); and the sole-evidence impairment branch does not apply because no impaired artifact carries a deciding fact. No clause produces a referral: the arrival marker was not false under POL-NS-05, the fare reconciles so no billing-integrity issue arises under POL-NS-08(d), and RIDER_NO_SHOW was not a mis-selected reason code. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically on issue. This ruling was made without human review; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
